acceptanceCriteria: The OpenCode package version is newer than or committed with its latest shipped-content change, and host-package-versions-check passes.
The package, runtime adapter version, compatibility matrix and current README agree; host adapter regressions pass.
Historical qualification evidence remains pinned to its measured version; no qualification is inferred for the new package version.
body: Observed during the 2026-09-28 full gate for journal/lock fixes at 3a6345491049c54db32eb53afdf6ccd20f4d4ef2. host-package-versions-check refuses OpenCode: package.json last bumped at 5e87d27de61aa13054bfc6d5cde9477b56b8d3e7, older than shipped README change at 885264baa9b3bd7cf4c43669e4cd983f99480847. Both commits precede this fix branch base decf36d6354a369c0afaa05b7c34ab1cf1e29c87, and main still contains version 0.4.0. The owner approved a 0.4.1 repair, then identified existing OpenCode 0.7.1 work in PR #333 (b2676d3a15b36fe714510fe6726eee5e441ce5ad). The redundant 0.4.1 patch was not applied. Resolution now depends on PR #333 landing and the required full gate passing on integrated main. This differs from V1-0452, which covers files omitted from the gate. Re-observed 2026-10-04 by a peer session: `make -s host-package-versions-check` still refuses OpenCode on main; integrations/opencode/package.json was last bumped at efa79e4b, older than a shipped-content change at bf459f25 (88334a0c on an older main). Acceptance is unchanged.
title: Advance OpenCode package version after shipped qualification README change
